decisionModel.question: Does the action carry visible text?

source: Every action-style control has a stable id and one control-inventory record.
Every inventory record resolves labelMode to exactly one geometryRole through this contract.
Product CSS does not override a protected geometry property on .btn or .btn-icon.
.btn-icon always appears together with .btn and an accessible name.
Tabs, segmented selectors, fields, disclosures, status, tags, and cards never use action-button classes merely to appear clickable.

checks: All action targets are at least 44 by 44 CSS px.
A labelled capsule has at least var(--space-5) inline padding, centres its contents, and wraps without clipping or ellipsis.
An icon-and-label capsule preserves the var(--space-2) gap and centres icon and label on the same axis.
An icon-only action renders as a 44 by 44 circle with zero inline padding and a centred approved icon.
Keyboard focus remains visible in both themes.
Long Thai remains readable at 200 percent zoom without horizontal page overflow.

behavior: The visible label or accessible name describes the immediate effect.
Every enabled action reaches its declared effect and recovery state in browser testing.
Disabled and busy specimens remain inert and readable.
The interactive builder is tested once in labelled mode and once after switching to icon-only mode.

accepted.markup: <button class="btn" type="button">ดูข้อมูลพื้นที่นี้</button>
accepted.reason: Visible text resolves to the inherited labelled capsule.
An icon plus visible text remains a capsule.
A standard icon-only action uses the inherited circular target and a real accessible name.

rejected.reason: A local button class can create a prohibited third geometry.

rejected.markup: <button class="btn btn-icon">ดูข้อมูล</button>
rejected.reason: Visible text cannot be forced into the icon-only circle.
An icon-only action without an accessible name is not usable.
